RagShortTexts: Crusading indulgences depend on authorization and fulfillment.
Confession and undertaken duties are not replaced by plunder.

Variants.Content: The Church offers spiritual benefits for authorized crusading, linked to preaching, confession and fulfillment. A temporary expedition differs from joining an order. Family arrangements, equipment and travel still need funding.
A recruit still needs commanders, assembly arrangements and equipment. Different hopes of penance or spoils can clash and undermine discipline.
A lord’s expedition requires government during absence and finance. Commitments beyond estate resources turn pious standing into debts borne by those remaining.
Families keep fields and care for dependants during an expedition. Spiritual promises do not grind household grain; assistance must account for absence and uncertain return.
